        & (~df["Worker_Type"].isin(["Contractor", "Agency", "Consultant"]))

    sep_df = df[sep_mask].copy()

    dept_seps.columns = ["Department", "separations"]

    month_ends = [
        ("Nov 2025", pd.Timestamp("2025-11-30"), 996),
        ("Dec 2025", pd.Timestamp("2025-12-31"), 999),
        ("Jan 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-01-31"), 994),
        ("Feb 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-02-28"), 997),
        ("Mar 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-03-31"), 1002),
        ("Apr 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-04-30"), 1000),
        ("May 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-05-31"), 1009),
        ("Jun 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-06-30"), 945),
        ("Jul 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-07-31"), 934),
        ("Aug 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-08-31"), 918),
        ("Sep 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-09-30"), 901),
        ("Oct 2026", pd.Timestamp("2026-10-31"), 885),
    ]

    in_hc_mask = (
        counted_mask
        & (~df["Worker_Type"].isin(["Contractor", "Agency", "Consultant"]))
    )
    hc_df = df[in_hc_mask].copy()

    dept_monthly_hc = {}
    for label, me, total_hc in month_ends:
        active_at = hc_df[
            (hc_df["Hire_Date_dt"] <= me)
            & (
                hc_df["Termination_Date_dt"].isna()
                | (hc_df["Termination_Date_dt"] > me)
            )
        ]
        dept_counts = active_at.groupby("Department")["Employee_ID"].nunique()
        for dept, cnt in dept_counts.items():
            if dept not in dept_monthly_hc:
                dept_monthly_hc[dept] = []
            dept_monthly_hc[dept].append(cnt)

    dept_avg_hc = {dept: np.mean(counts) for dept, counts in dept_monthly_hc.items()}

    dept_results = []
    for _, row in dept_seps.iterrows():
        dept = row["Department"]
        seps = row["separations"]
        d_avg_hc = dept_avg_hc.get(dept, None)
        if d_avg_hc and d_avg_hc > 0:
            rate = round(seps / d_avg_hc, 4)
        else:
            rate = None
        if rate is not None:
            dept_results.append({"name": dept, "value": rate})

    dept_results_sorted = sorted(dept_results, key=lambda x: x["value"], reverse=True)

    overall_seps = sep_df["Employee_ID"].nunique()
    overall_rate = round(overall_seps / avg_hc, 4)

    result["segments"].append({
        "segment_column": "Department",
        "metric_column": "Termination_Date",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "attrition_rate",
        "results": dept_results_sorted
    })

    result["segments"].append({
        "segment_column": "Department",
        "metric_column": "Termination_Date",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "attrition_rate_overall",
        "results": [{"name": "Overall", "value": overall_rate}]
    })

    result["assumptions"].append(
        "Attrition = voluntary + involuntary separations (retirements excluded) Nov 2025–Oct 2026 ÷ average headcount 965.0; contractors/agency/consultants excluded."
    )
    result["assumptions"].append(
        "Department-level average headcount derived from row-level data for the same 12 month-ends; overall average headcount is the provided figure of 965.0."
    )
    result["assumptions"].append(
        "5 hire/exit dates after 31 Oct 2026 are not counted per domain rules."
    )

except Exception as e:
    result["segments"].append({
        "segment_column": "Department",
        "metric_column": "Termination_Date",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "attrition_rate",
        "results": [{"name": "error", "value": -1.0}]
    })
    result["assumptions"].append(f"Segmentation error: {str(e)}")
